extensionDescription: Translates live chat messages in real-time on popular streaming platforms like YouTube, Twitch, and Kick.

popup.unsupportedBody: Chatslator works on YouTube, Twitch and Kick.

supportCard.title: Support the development
supportCard.body: I develop and maintain this in my spare time. If it's been helpful, I'd be grateful if you'd consider supporting its continued development with a small contribution.

settings.title: Chatslator settings
settings.description: Everything the extension does, in one place. Keep the same configuration across every platform, or customize YouTube, Twitch, and Kick independently.

interface.title: Interface language
interface.description: The language of Chatslator’s own screens. What chat gets translated into is set below.
interface.label: Language
interface.contributeHint: Missing your language, or found a mistake in one?

sync.title: Sync settings across platforms
sync.on: YouTube, Twitch and Kick share one configuration.
sync.off: Each platform is configured separately. Turning this on copies $1’s settings to the other two.

translation.title: Translation
translation.descriptionAll: What Chatslator does on every platform.

enable.title: Translate $1 chat
enable.on: Incoming messages are translated as they arrive.
enable.off: Chatslator stays out of the way on this site.

sourceTooltip.title: Show the detected language on hover
sourceTooltip.on: Hovering a translation names the language it came from.

display.title: Display mode
display.description: Where the translation goes in relation to the original message.

color.title: Translation color
color.description: Applied to the translated portion of every message.

settings.autosave: Changes save automatically and apply to new chat messages.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.description: Every version of Chatslator, newest first. Retrieved live from the repository, so you can see the latest releases before they're available in the extension stores.
changelog.error: Couldn't reach the changelog. Check your connection and reload.
changelog.updatePendingHint: Your browser installs the update automatically once the store approves the new version. Thanks for your patience!

supporters.title: Supporters
supporters.description: Chatslator is free and built by one person. The people below help fund its continued development and keep the project alive. Thank you for your support.
supporters.error: Couldn't reach the supporters list. Check your connection and reload.
supporters.tierOpen: This tier is open. It could be you.
supporters.emptyBody: Your name could sit right here. Support keeps the extension updated and the servers answering.
supporters.ctaNone: Every contribution goes straight back into development.

ctaJoin.1: Join 1 person keeping Chatslator free for everyone.
ctaJoin.n: Join $1 people keeping Chatslator free for everyone.

support.title: Support Chatslator
support.body: Thanks for using Chatslator. If it's made your streams easier to follow, consider supporting its continued development and helping keep the project alive.
